_about: BDS-CHG-001 v0.8 §10.17 BDS-DES-16 common states: one catalogue read by the server (bid_submission/services/common_states.py) and the portal (public/js/bid_portal/components/CommonState.vue). `heading` and `action` are the board E / §10.17 copy verbatim. `message` is the live copy with {figures} filled from the read; `board_message` is what board E draws in the cell when that is an instruction to the builder rather than copy (the live message then says it in the bidder's words). `added` rows are not in §10.17 (new copy for review, BDS-CHG-001 v0.8 follow-ups).

states.label: Sign-in required
states.heading: Sign in to start or continue a bid.
states.message: Return to this Tender after authentication.

states.label: Forbidden Account
states.heading: You do not have access to this supplier account
states.message: Ask an Authorised Signatory for {organisation} to add you as a Supplier Representative.

states.label: Account suspended
states.heading: This supplier account cannot submit bids.
states.message: Preparation and change actions are unavailable. Existing receipts remain available through the authorised recovery route.

states.label: Tender not found
states.heading: Tender not found.
states.message: Return to Tenders.

states.label: Format unsupported
states.heading: This bid format is not available.
states.message: No bid was created for this Tender. Contact supplier support.
states.board_message: Do not create a partial workspace; contact support.

states.label: Load failure
states.heading: Bid could not be loaded
states.message: Your saved bid has not changed.

states.label: Stale Draft
states.heading: Another person changed this bid. Reload before continuing.
states.message: Compare the refreshed Draft before saving.

states.label: Evidence rejected
states.heading: This file could not be accepted.
states.message: {reason}
states.board_message: Show the safe type, size or scan reason without internal details.

states.label: Clarification closed
states.heading: The clarification deadline has passed.
states.message: Existing answers remain available; no question was sent.

states.label: Notice contact missing
states.heading: Choose a verified email for Tender notices.
states.message: Add or verify an Account email before starting the bid.

states.label: Notice delivery problem
states.heading: A Tender notice could not be delivered to your selected email.
states.message: The current Tender documents and notices remain available in this bid.

states.label: Supplier information unavailable — new visitor
states.heading: Supplier support information is temporarily unavailable.
states.message: You can read this Tender. Starting a new bid is unavailable until support and legal information is restored.

states.label: Supplier information unavailable — existing Draft holder
states.heading: Supplier support information is temporarily unavailable.
states.message: Your saved bid is still here. You can review and save it; submitting or replacing a bid is unavailable until this information is restored.

states.label: Supplier information unavailable — submitted bidder
states.heading: Supplier support information is temporarily unavailable.
states.message: Your submitted bid and receipt remain available. This message does not change its status.

states.label: Production submission not enabled
states.heading: Electronic bid submission is not available yet. Your bid remains saved and has not been submitted.
states.message: Submissions close {deadline}. You can continue preparing your bid.
states.board_message: Show the current deadline and configured Supplier support; preparation may continue. Do not suggest a restoration time.

states.label: Submission unavailable
states.heading: Electronic submission is temporarily unavailable. Your bid remains saved.
states.message: Nothing was submitted.

states.label: Signing service unavailable
states.heading: Digital signing is temporarily unavailable. Your bid remains saved and has not been submitted.
states.message: The signing service is being restored. Submissions close {deadline}.
states.board_message: Your certificate is valid; the signing service is being restored. Show deadline and configured support route.

states.label: Definitive custody failure
states.heading: The tender box rejected this attempt. Your bid remains saved and was not submitted.
states.message: Reference {rejection_reference}; current server time {current_time}; deadline {deadline}.
states.board_message: Reference TBX-REJECT-033-01; current server time and deadline.

states.label: Confirmation pending
states.heading: Submission confirmation is still pending. Do not submit again.
states.message: Correlation {correlation_id}; support reference {support_reference}. KenTender is checking this same attempt. You may leave and return to View status.

states.label: Deadline passed
states.heading: The submission deadline has passed. This bid was not submitted.
states.message: Deadline {deadline}; trusted server time {current_time}.

states.label: Idempotency conflict
states.heading: This request was already used with different information. Stop and refresh.
states.message: The original attempt is unchanged.

states.label: Replacement conflict
states.heading: A newer submitted bid already exists.
states.message: The current receipt is {receipt_reference}. Neither Version was changed.
states.board_message: Show receipt RCPT-MOH-2027-033-002; do not change either Version.

states.label: Tender cancelled
states.heading: This Tender is not accepting bids.
states.message: Status Cancelled; view the cancellation notice for details.

states.label: Bid not found
states.heading: Bid not found.
states.message: This bid is unavailable or you do not have permission to view it.

states.label: Receipt not found
states.heading: Receipt not found.
states.message: This receipt is unavailable or you do not have permission to view it.

states.label: Page not found
states.heading: Page not found.
states.message: This page is unavailable or you do not have permission to view it.

states.label: Not submitted
states.heading: This bid has not been submitted.
states.message: No submission attempt is recorded for this bid.
